mother-brief.text: Your first solo flight, sweetie. Five specimens. Cows if you can. Try not to dent anything else.
Seven specimens, and Mother is craving bacon research. A pig, dear. And watch that man in the foil hat.
The suits in sunglasses are here. Our beam bounces off them. Drop something heavy on one, then try.
Nine specimens from the cornfield. Rumour says there's a golden cow out there. Rumour is Mother.
The army rolled in a tank. You can't lift it, but a cow from a great height works wonders.
A whole army base. Lasers, jets, the works. Ten specimens. Mother believes in you. Mostly.
Their secret hangar. Twelve specimens, and Mother would simply LOVE an agent for her collection.
General Grumbles built a tank the size of a barn. Beam up livestock. Drop it on him. Six times. Go!

mother-grade.text: Flawless! Mother is putting this on the fridge.
A plus! Who's a good little saucer? You are!
Perfection. I may cry into my antennae.
Excellent work, sweetie. Hardly a scratch.
A! Mother is proud. Don't let it go to your dome.
A solid B. Your cousin got an A, but who's counting. Mother is.
C. As in "Could have tried harder."
D. Did you even look at the brief?
Mother is not angry. Mother is disappointed.
F! Back down there and do it again, young saucer!
Zero stars. Not even a moon. Try again.

mother-radio.text: Quota met! Dock with Mother, or grab a few extras.
That's the quota! Hover under me to dock.
Oh, not AGAIN. Sending a spare.
That's coming out of your allowance.
Hold's full! Bring them up to Mother.
No more room, sweetie. Come unload.
Into the freezer they go. Kidding! Mostly.
Down he goes! Now come home for supper.
